title: LDAP Identity and SIP Digest credential boundary
summary: SIP dev17 can lazily provision Digest credentials from the platform Identity Directory and Secret Broker without making LDAP part of call/media ownership. Identity Directory supplies active principal/credential metadata; Secret Broker materializes the referenced secret; SIP immediately provisions its native Digest engine for that request.
invariants: LDAP Identity owns principal and credential metadata; SIP owns SIP Digest protocol verification.
Secret material is acquired only through Secret Broker and the lease is retired before the provider returns.
No raw credential value is written to Alchemy Log or Instrumentation Mesh.
Provider failure is fail-closed and invalidates a previously provisioned native credential before verification.
The adapter is optional; calls, RTP, AudioIn, AudioOut, STT and TTS do not depend on LDAP lifecycle.
SIP does not modify LDAP Identity source or emulate LDAP authentication internally.
procedure: Use an ACTIVE Identity Directory principal and ACTIVE currently-valid SIP_DIGEST_SECRET credential.
Configure SipLdapIdentityCredentialProvider with the Identity Directory and Secret Broker objects, then inject it into SipServer.
Treat a missing/revoked/inactive identity, credential, broker lease or provider failure as authentication denial.
For production acceptance, execute a real REGISTER challenge/response against LDAP/Secret Broker and verify revoke/failure denial over the wire.

provenance.claim: Optional Identity Directory + Secret Broker credential provider implementation.
Identity Directory credential metadata and Secret Broker lease/materialization model consumed by SIP dev17.
